parsed.name: Prior 电动 XY 载物台
parsed.description: 用于显微镜或实验平台样品定位的电动二维平移载物台，可读取当前位置，并执行 X/Y 方向微米级相对移动与指定坐标绝对移动，同时检查软限位和硬限位以避免超程。
parsed.description_en: A motorized 2D translation stage for sample positioning on microscopes or laboratory platforms. It can report the current position, perform micron-scale relative motion in X and Y, move to specified coordinates, and check soft and hard travel limits to avoid overtravel.

actions.description: 获取载物台当前 XY 位置。
actions.description_en: Get the current XY position of the stage.

actions.description: 沿 X 方向相对移动载物台。
actions.description_en: Move the stage relatively along the X axis.

actions.description: 沿 Y 方向相对移动载物台。
actions.description_en: Move the stage relatively along the Y axis.

actions.description: 将载物台移动到指定 XY 坐标。
actions.description_en: Move the stage to the specified XY coordinates.

actions.description: 将载物台执行绝对坐标移动。
actions.description_en: Move the stage using absolute coordinates.

actions.description: 检查载物台硬限位状态。
actions.description_en: Check the hard limit status of the stage.

actions.description: 检查相对移动是否会超过软限位。
actions.description_en: Check whether a relative move would exceed the soft limits.

actions.description: 检查目标绝对坐标是否超出软限位。
actions.description_en: Check whether the target absolute coordinates exceed the soft limits.

actions.description: 查询指定操作的错误信息。
actions.description_en: Query error information for a specified operation.
